name: snRNA-seq of human optic nerve and optic nerve head - fibroblasts
description: We identified 8 cell types/states of fibroblasts from over 100,000 snRNA-seq cells derived from human optic nerve and optic nerve head.

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: We used scVI for data integration and then manually annotated each cell cluster with scanpy based on marker gene expression

labels.name: Fibro_sclera
labels.rationale: A fibroblast sub cluster that expresses NOX4

labels.name: Fibro_RPEchoroid
labels.rationale: A fibroblast sub cluster that expresses BMP5

labels.name: Fibro_dura
labels.rationale: A fibroblast sub cluster that expresses SLC47A1 and THSD4

labels.name: Fibro_pia
labels.rationale: A fibroblast sub cluster that expresses AL445250 and ABCA9

labels.name: Fibro_perivascular
labels.rationale: A fibroblast sub cluster that expresses MGP and APOD

labels.name: Fibro_arachnoid
labels.rationale: A fibroblast sub cluster that expresses CEMIP and PKP2

labels.name: Fibro_lamina_cribrosa
labels.rationale: A fibroblast sub cluster that expresses SHOX and SMOC2

labels.name: Fibro_x
labels.rationale: A fibroblast sub cluster that expresses EBF2 and SLC22A3
